actions.description: Create a new client (company) in Timely.

actions.description: Log a new time entry against a project.

day.description: Day the time is logged for, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

id.description: Unique ID of the created time entry.

note.description: Note attached to the time entry, or null when none was provided.

hours.description: Whole hours portion of the logged duration.

minutes.description: Whole minutes portion of the logged duration.

seconds.description: Whole seconds portion of the logged duration.

formatted.description: Duration formatted as HH:MM.

total_seconds.description: Total logged duration expressed in seconds.

rate_type.description: Billing rate type of the project, e.g. "non-billable".

user.description: User the time entry was logged by.

user_name.description: Display name of the user who logged the time entry, or null when Timely omits it.

project_id.description: ID of the project the time was logged against.

project_name.description: Name of the project the time was logged against, or null when Timely omits it.

client_id.description: ID of the client that owns the project, or null when the project has no client.

client_name.description: Name of the client that owns the project, or null when the project has no client.

day.description: Calendar day the time entry belongs to, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

note.description: Free-text note attached to the time entry, or null when none was provided.

duration_hours.description: Whole-hours component of the logged duration.

duration_minutes.description: Minutes component of the logged duration (0-59).

duration_seconds.description: Seconds component of the logged duration (0-59).

duration_total_hours.description: Total logged duration expressed in decimal hours (e.g. 1.5 for 1h30m).

duration_formatted.description: Total logged duration formatted as HH:MM.

estimated_duration_total_hours.description: Estimated duration for the entry in decimal hours, or 0 when no estimate exists.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable to the client.

billed.description: Whether the time entry has already been billed.

billed_at.description: Timestamp at which the entry was billed, or null when not yet billed.

cost_amount.description: Monetary cost amount recorded for the time entry.

cost_currency_code.description: ISO currency code (lowercase) in which the cost amount is expressed.

hour_rate.description: Hourly rate applied to the time entry.

external_id.description: Caller-supplied external identifier for the entry, or null when unset.

label_ids.description: IDs of the labels attached to the time entry.

locked.description: Whether the time entry is locked against further edits.

locked_reason.description: Reason the time entry is locked, or null when it is not locked.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the event was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the event was last updated.

created_from.description: Source that created the event (e.g. Web, Nango), or null when unknown.

updated_from.description: Source that last updated the event (e.g. Web, Nango), or null when unknown.

creator_id.description: ID of the user who created the event.

updater_id.description: ID of the user who last updated the event.

deleted.description: Whether Timely marks the event as deleted.

Event.description: A Timely time entry (event) logged within the configured day window.

since.description: Inclusive start of the day window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 90 days before the run date.

upto.description: Inclusive end of the day window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the run date.

SyncMetadata_timely_events.description: Optional caller-configured day range for the events sync; omit it to sync the trailing 90 days.

syncs.description: Sync all projects in the account.
syncs.name: projects

id.description: Unique project identifier (the provider numeric id as a string).

account_id.description: Numeric id of the Timely account that owns the project.

description.description: Project description, or null when unset.

color.description: Project color as a hex string without a leading #, or null when unset.

rate_type.description: Rate type used by the project, for example "user" or "non-billable".

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the project was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the project was last updated.

external_id.description: Caller-supplied external identifier, or null when unset.

budget_scope.description: Budget scope of the project, or null when no budget is scoped.

client.description: Client (company) the project belongs to, when one is set.

color.description: Client color as a hex string without a leading #, or null when unset.

external_id.description: Caller-supplied external identifier, or null when unset.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the client was last updated.

required_notes.description: Whether notes are required on events logged against the project.

required_labels.description: Whether labels are required on events logged against the project.

budget_expired_on.description: Date the project budget expires, or null when it does not expire.

has_recurrence.description: Whether the project has a recurring schedule.

enable_labels.description: Label mode for the project, for example "none" or "all".

default_labels.description: Whether default labels are applied to events logged against the project.

name.description: Currency display name, for example "Kenyan Shilling".

symbol_first.description: Whether the currency symbol is shown before the amount.

team_ids.description: Numeric ids of the teams the project is shared with.

budget_type.description: Project budget type, or an empty string when unset.

budget_calculation.description: How the project budget is calculated, for example "pending".

hour_rate.description: Default billable hourly rate for the project.

hour_rate_in_cents.description: Default billable hourly rate in cents for the project.

budget_progress.description: Amount of budget consumed so far.

budget_percent.description: Percentage of budget consumed so far.

invoice_by_budget.description: Whether the project is invoiced against its budget.

user_id.description: Numeric id of the user assigned to the project.

hour_rate.description: Billable hourly rate for this user on the project.

hour_rate_in_cents.description: Billable hourly rate in cents for this user on the project.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this project-user link was last updated.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this project-user link was created.

deleted.description: Whether this user has been removed from the project.

internal_hour_rate.description: Internal cost hourly rate for this user on the project.

internal_hour_rate_in_cents.description: Internal cost hourly rate in cents for this user on the project.

project_id.description: Numeric id of the project the label is attached to.

label_id.description: Numeric id of the attached label.

budget.description: Budget assigned to this label within the project.

required.description: Whether the label is required on events for the project.

default.description: Whether the label is applied by default to new events.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this project-label link was last updated.

label_ids.description: Numeric ids of the labels attached to the project.

required_label_ids.description: Numeric ids of the labels required on events for the project.

default_label_ids.description: Numeric ids of the labels applied by default to new events.

fractional.description: Cost amount as a fractional value.

formatted.description: Cost amount formatted with its currency symbol.

amount.description: Cost amount as an integer in minor units.

currency_code.description: Currency code the cost is expressed in.

minutes.description: Whole minutes component of the duration.

seconds.description: Whole seconds component of the duration.

formatted.description: Duration formatted as HH:MM.

total_hours.description: Total duration expressed in hours.

unbilled_duration.description: All-time unbilled duration for the project.

created_from.description: Source the project was created from, for example "Nango".

allow_only_one_tag.description: Whether only one label may be applied to events for the project.

syncs.description: Sync all users (team members) in the account.
syncs.name: users

id.description: Stable unique record identifier for the user, scoped to its Timely account as "<account_id>-<user_id>".

user_id.description: Timely's numeric user ID, represented as a string.

account_id.description: Timely account ID this user record belongs to.

email.description: Email address the user signs in to Timely with.

name.description: Full display name of the user.

active.description: Whether the user account is currently active.

admin.description: Whether the user is an account administrator.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the user was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the user was last updated.

sign_in_count.description: Total number of times the user has signed in.

time_zone.description: Time zone configured for the user (e.g. 'Africa/Nairobi').

work_days.description: Comma-separated list of the days of the week the user works (e.g. MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI).

weekdays.description: Comma-separated two-letter codes of the user's working weekdays (e.g. MO,TU,WE,TH,FR).

weekly_capacity.description: Weekly working capacity of the user in hours.

default_hour_rate.description: Default billable hourly rate applied to the user.

internal_hour_rate.description: Internal (cost) hourly rate applied to the user.

hide_hourly_rate.description: Whether the billable hourly rate is hidden for the user.

hide_internal_hourly_rate.description: Whether the internal hourly rate is hidden for the user.

role_id.description: ID of the role assigned to the user.

id.description: ID of the role assigned to the user.

avatar.description: Avatar image URLs for the user.

large_retina.description: URL of the large retina avatar image.

large.description: URL of the large avatar image.

medium_retina.description: URL of the medium retina avatar image.

medium.description: URL of the medium avatar image.

small_retina.description: URL of the small retina avatar image.

small.description: URL of the small avatar image.

day_view_onboarded.description: Whether the user has completed the day-view onboarding flow.

memory_onboarded.description: Whether the user has completed the memories onboarding flow.

external_id.description: External identifier for the user, when one has been set.

last_received_memories_date.description: Date the user last received memories, when any exist.

memory_retention_days.description: Number of days of memories retained for the user, when a limit is set.

deleted.description: Whether the user is marked as deleted in Timely.

User.description: A Timely user (a team member in the account).
